name: Aura Music
description: An open-source Android music streaming and downloading application. Stream, discover, and download high-quality music completely ad-free with background playback and offline caching.
whatItDoes: Allows users to search, stream, and directly download high-quality audio tracks completely free of ads, with background audio playback, offline storage, and lock-screen media controls.
features: 100% Ad-free streaming and uninterrupted playback
Direct high-quality music download for offline listening
Background audio playback with lock screen media controls
Open-source codebase with lightweight, battery-efficient design
Clean dark-mode mobile interface with instant search
aiRole: AI-assisted audio buffering algorithms and build automation.
impact: Open-source standalone release Android APK (26 MB).

readmeSections.heading: Overview
readmeSections.text: Aura Music is an open-source, ad-free Android music application built for music lovers who value privacy, speed, and offline access.

name: RK Fitness
description: A complete fitness club and membership portal built with Next.js, featuring dynamic workout plans, trainer profiles, and modern dark-mode aesthetics.
whatItDoes: Enables fitness enthusiasts to browse programs, schedule personal training, calculate fitness metrics, and explore membership packages.
features: Next.js App Router with Server-Side Rendering and fast hydration
High-contrast dark-mode editorial visual design
Interactive workout calculators and schedule viewer
Complete bundled source distribution available for download
aiRole: Rapid component design iteration and semantic responsive layouts.
impact: High Lighthouse performance rating and modular component architecture.

readmeSections.heading: System Architecture
readmeSections.text: Built on Next.js with optimized image pipelines, Tailwind utility styling, and modular TypeScript components.

name: Webza OS
description: A browser-based desktop operating system simulation featuring draggable, resizable windows, taskbar system, and modular virtual applications.
whatItDoes: Recreates a desktop computing environment directly in the browser using pure web standards and lightweight DOM rendering.
features: Multi-window manager with z-index stacking, dragging, and resizing
System dock / taskbar with running app indicators
Virtual desktop utilities and custom theme engine
Zero external runtime dependencies
aiRole: DOM math modeling for boundaries, resize snapping, and window state persistence.
impact: Demonstrates deep mastery of vanilla JavaScript event loops and DOM manipulation.

readmeSections.heading: Window Management
readmeSections.text: Features a customized lightweight windowing engine built from scratch without external canvas or heavy desktop libraries.

name: Roshan Jewel
description: An editorial e-commerce experience crafted for a luxury jewelry house, featuring smooth catalog filtering, high-resolution showcases, and cart persistence.
whatItDoes: Showcases handcrafted gold and diamond collections with modern micro-interactions, responsive grids, and clean checkout flows.
features: Sophisticated luxury color palette and serif-accented typography
Real-time category and metal/stone filtering
Persistent client-side shopping bag state
Optimized media delivery and responsive product cards
aiRole: Tailwind styling refinement and accessible form components.
impact: Smooth 60fps animations and seamless mobile shopping experience.

readmeSections.heading: E-Commerce Experience
readmeSections.text: Crafted with attention to micro-interactions, smooth hover transitions, and clean typography hierarchy.

name: FreeLLM API
description: A lightweight proxy service and developer interface designed to streamline free AI model endpoints for rapid local prototyping and experimentation.
whatItDoes: Bridges client requests to available LLM inference providers with unified request/response schemas and rate-limit handling.
features: Unified OpenAI-compatible completion format
Automated error recovery and fallback provider switching
Lightweight local server footprint
Simple CLI testing interface
aiRole: Prompt engineering, token optimization, and payload streaming.
impact: Accelerates local AI app development without expensive API subscriptions.

readmeSections.heading: Integration
readmeSections.text: Can be consumed like any standard OpenAI endpoint for local coding assistants or web prototypes.
